Subject: Request: one-off commission & payment terms for AWS listing (Nimbus Data)

Team —

Quick summary: Nimbus Data is asking to list via an AWS Private Offer and has requested two non-standard asks we need exec sign-off for: a one-off elevated commission to AWS channel/partner at 30% (standard is 20%) and Net45 payment terms (we default to Net30 for Marketplace flows). The ARR is USD 1,200,000 (12-month commitment) and they want the listing live in AWS by Jan 10 to align with their procurement window.

Why this matters: Nimbus is fast-moving and a strategic proof point for our storage use-case in verticals. We have a strong chance to convert a second enterprise within 90d if we move quickly. The math on our side with the proposed elevated commission still yields positive unit economics at expected utilization, but it tightens margin.

Ask: Seeking approval for: 1) one-off commission/fee carve-in to AWS/partner at 30% for this listing only; 2) Net45 payment term (invoice to Redwood) for this contract; 3) permission to finalize the AWS private-offer draft attached and route to DocuSign.

Attachments: Nimbus_Signed_MOU.pdf (customer MOU), AWS_Private_Offer_Draft.pdf (redline), ROI_Model_Nimbus.xlsx (calc).

Please reply with OK, OK-with-conditions, or Need-more-info. If approved, I will coordinate with Legal to lock the clause and instruct AWS partner to list.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova

Subject: Re: Request: one-off commission & payment terms for AWS listing (Nimbus Data)

Thanks Sofia — good concise package. A couple of clarifying items from my side before we escalate formally to Finance/RevOps:

- Is the 30% ask inclusive of AWS marketplace fees (i.e., the partner carve we pay) or is it an additional rebate on top of marketplace fees? My read from the draft is AWS takes its standard cut and the partner wants the residual 30% of Redwood line-item; confirm.
- Do we have approval to grant this exception only for the first 12 months, and revert to standard 20% on renewal unless we re-authorize? I want a guardrail so this doesn't become a new precedent.
- Can we accept Net45 only if we escrow a 5% early-payment holdback or similar? If Finance is uncomfortable, propose Net30 + 15 days of AWS payout tolerance.

If those three boxes are ticked I am inclined to greenlight from Sales. Nimbus is high priority for the vertical playbook.

Karthik
Director, Cloud Partnerships

All —

Finance has reviewed the ROI spreadsheet and the cashflow impact. We can approve the 30% one-off commission limited to the first 12 months only; this must be documented as a timeboxed exception and flagged in our RevOps rules so it does not auto-apply to other deals.

On payment terms: Finance will accept Net45 only if we enforce a 5% holdback refundable after 30 days of verified payment and usage reconciliation. Alternatively, Sales can agree to Net30 and we will make an exception on AWS payout alignment for 15 days. For speed, I recommend adopting the 5% holdback on this contract.
